name: Vim like Neovim (dotfiles)
description: Makes Vim mode work like Neovim with dotfiles-windows: shows the mode in the status bar like lualine, highlights the cursor line in the active pane, turns the IME off outside Insert mode, and Ctrl+O / Ctrl+I go back / forward in Normal mode. The IME part needs ime.exe next to it, which dotfiles-windows' install.ps1 puts there.
author: dotfiles-windows
